Corgi magic, at its most basic level, is the act of channeling the flow of energy that emanates from the core of Gaea through oneself in order to use this flow of energy to interact with objects, particles and the like in ways that would normally be impossible. Once the energy enters into his heart the practitioner is able to control the flow of energy through his body. In order to process and refine this energy, a skilled practitioner will direct the flow of energy through his liver. Once the energy flow has been accepted and refined, the energy can then be directed outwards through the limbs allowing the practitioner to telekinetically interact with the world around him. The necessary process to control this flow of energy puts an amount of strain on a practitioner's body which is determined by a combination of the amount of effort one puts into calling the energy, how delicate the flow is being used (masterful practitioners will further refine the energy through various other organs in order to have more precise control over the flow), and the duration of how long the energy flows through the body. Because the flow of energy emanates from the core of Gaea, the further a practitioner is from the core, the less energy is available to be channeled. For example: A skilled practitioner on the surface of Gaea may have difficulties manipulating anything heavier than a three-kilogram stone whereas near the core the same practitioner would have little difficulty lifting a boulder in excess of thirty-kilograms.

To combat this limitation, the Sophons have developed an amplifier for the flow of energy. Through the use of Corgi Magic, skilled practitioners are able to take a refined chunk of gaell ore and subject it to a complex series of vibrations. This process can only be reliably and safely done while the practitioners are very close to the core of Gaea. At the end of this process, which may take between two weeks to a month of processing, the chunk turns into a thick ball of metallic foam. When an electrical current is passed through this foam, a skilled practitioner of corgi magic can direct his controlled flow through this charged foam to greatly boost the power of his magic. The usual method of using an amplifier involves a practitioner channeling the energy flow into his legs and out through his feet, out into and through the charged foam, back into himself through the area of his upper back and then out through his arms.
